analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – the combination of a physical book and digital app with AR is an interesting concept. However, the ‘supporting pediatric care’ aspect feels somewhat tacked on and could be strengthened.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Decent market size – children’s books and educational apps are large. However, the specific niche of ‘co-creating stories’ needs further validation.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Prototype exists, self-published story – shows some initial progress. Patent-pending claim is a weak indicator of true feasibility without further details. Roadmap is vague.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Licensing model is plausible, but dependent on widespread adoption. 10% donation is a good ethical commitment.', 'Differentiation': '• Moderate differentiation – the blend of physical and digital is somewhat familiar. The social-emotional learning framing adds a layer.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Limited impact plan – relies heavily on the donation commitment. No concrete metrics for measuring educational impact beyond ‘supporting social-emotional learning’.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Acknowledges funding risk – basic risk assessment.  Reliance on a single, female-led team is a potential vulnerability.', 'Pros': '• Combines physical and digital elements.  Clear educational framing.  Existing prototype.', 'Cons': '• Vague roadmap. Weak patent claim. Limited impact plan. Reliance on a single team.'}, 'Project B': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Strong and clearly articulated – solving the problem of digital authenticity and providing verifiable provenance is a compelling value proposition.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Large market – brands and consumers are increasingly concerned with ethical sourcing and supply chain transparency. Initial target user group is well-defined.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Lightweight implementation and focus on privacy are good.  Demo and proof-of-concept demonstrate early progress.  Demand validation plan is sensible.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Subscription model is a standard and viable approach. Tiered pricing is a good starting point.', 'Differentiation': '• High differentiation – the focus on verifiable provenance, integration with certification bodies, and protocol-agnostic design are key differentiators.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Strong impact plan – measuring the reduction in verification time is a concrete metric.  Partnership with a certification body provides a clear goal.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Focus on privacy and lightweight implementation mitigates some risks. Demand validation plan helps assess market interest.', 'Pros': '• Strong value proposition. Well-defined target market. Clear development plan. High differentiation.', 'Cons': '• Reliance on partnerships for full functionality.  Subscription model is still speculative.'}}
